caseName: Paris & Great Northern Railroad v. Boston
caseNameFull: Paris & Great Northern Railroad Company, in Error v. Mrs. Georgia Boston
summary: In error to the Court of Civil Appeals for the Sixth Supreme Judicial District of the State of Texas.
attorneys: Mr. W. F. Evans and Mr. Edgar Wright for the plaintiff in error., Mr. Fred B. Rhodes for the defendants in error.
